scope: SIH26171 privacy-preserving visual browser agent; prototype v0.1 in validation

deadline.source: user instruction; not verified as official SIH deadline

release_policy.fail: Reject candidate; repair and retest affected criteria.
release_policy.unknown: Block release readiness claim until evidence is collected.
release_policy.pass: Evidence matches current build, environment and rule.
release_policy.overall: PASS only if every mandatory rule is pass; otherwise FAIL if any fail exists, else UNKNOWN. No score averages can override a failed guardrail.
release_policy.artifact_delivery: Preparation artifacts may be delivered with conspicuous NOT SUBMISSION READY labels; delivery is not release approval.

rules.name: Verified problem identity
rules.acceptance: Exact corrected SIH26171 identifier, 2026 year, issuing organization, full statement and official source captured.
rules.verification_method: Inspect official problem page or organizer-issued record and preserve provenance.
rules.reason: Full user supplied statement cross-checked against retrieved organizer catalogue on 9 September 2026. Initial SIH2171 shorthand superseded.

rules.name: Six-person delivery ceiling
rules.acceptance: One bounded primary user journey, <=2 application services, <=1 primary database, <=1 optional external provider; no new custom-model training, mandatory specialized hardware or unsupported integration before 11 September.
rules.verification_method: Review architecture and dependency inventory; any justified exception must include measured time and fallback.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Reproducible complete workflow
rules.acceptance: Every frozen critical acceptance scenario passes from clean setup to persisted result and reload; no mocked action presented as live.
rules.verification_method: Run end-to-end tests against a clean database and verify restart persistence.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Evidence-backed differentiation
rules.acceptance: At least 3 relevant adjacent solutions compared; >=1 domain-relevant differentiator implemented and demonstrated against a baseline; global first/unique claims forbidden without evidence.
rules.verification_method: Source-backed feature comparison plus reproducible baseline demonstration.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Prototype capacity floor
rules.acceptance: At least 20 concurrent sessions and 1000 synthetic records for 5 minutes; <1% unexpected request failures; no lost writes. Capacity is a prototype target, not national-scale proof.
rules.verification_method: Run fixed-seed local load scenario on recorded hardware, check data counts and error classes.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Validated requests and safe output
rules.acceptance: Server validates types, lengths, bounds and allowed fields; queries parameterized; HTML output safely encoded; malformed payload returns controlled 4xx; no stack traces or secrets returned.
rules.verification_method: Negative API cases, injection strings, overlong input and source review.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Access and data boundaries
rules.acceptance: Any private record requires server authorization and ownership checks. Public demo uses synthetic, non-sensitive data and is explicitly labeled. No real personal data or credentials in fixtures, logs or client bundles.
rules.verification_method: Unauthenticated and cross-user access tests where applicable; inspect environment handling and demo data.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Deployment controls
rules.acceptance: HTTPS on public deployments; origin policy and CSRF defenses appropriate to auth model; bounded request bodies and write rate limits; production debug off; dependency/secret scans with no unresolved critical or high findings.
rules.verification_method: Inspect headers, negative origin/write tests and locked dependency scans.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: WCAG 2.1 AA review
rules.acceptance: All applicable WCAG 2.1 A/AA criteria documented and checked; no known blocker. Automated checks plus manual keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, reflow, zoom, labels and status review.
rules.verification_method: Record criterion-level pass/fail/not-applicable with evidence. No blanket conformance claim from Lighthouse or axe alone.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Responsive and motion safety
rules.acceptance: No essential content lost at 320px/390px/1440px, 200% zoom or reduced motion; all actions keyboard-accessible with visible focus; no forced orientation, autoplay audio or animation-only information.
rules.verification_method: Browser review at declared viewports and preferences with screenshots.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Core response time
rules.acceptance: Each frozen core user flow has p95 end-to-end completion <200ms on the declared local reference environment, with at least 100 measured attempts per flow after 10 warmups. Long external tasks cannot be relabeled core completion; report job acceptance and full completion separately.
rules.verification_method: Measure action event to visible usable result including backend/persistence; record cold startup and remote-network measurements separately.
rules.reason: Real local Qwen reasoning calls observed at 3029ms and 2276ms. Full workflow exceeds 200ms; a 108ms local capture does not satisfy this rule.

rules.name: Website Lighthouse quality
rules.acceptance: For both mobile and desktop, median of 3 runs is strictly >90 in performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO; no category omitted. Record all runs and environment.
rules.verification_method: Run production build in clean Chrome profile; preserve JSON/HTML reports and exact URL/version. A rounded 90 fails.
rules.reason: Six fresh Lighthouse 12.8.2 runs of the Sightline site on local loopback: three mobile and three desktop, 100 in all four categories. Automated site scores only; not WCAG conformance or prototype performance.

rules.name: Error recovery
rules.acceptance: All frozen critical fault scenarios recover without lost committed data, duplicate submission or unexplained dead-end; timeouts and validation errors offer usable next steps.
rules.verification_method: Inject malformed input, offline/failed fetch, duplicate submit, unavailable provider and server restart as applicable.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Live and recorded fallback
rules.acceptance: Critical journey succeeds in 3 consecutive rehearsals from reset; local offline-safe demonstration or labeled prerecorded fallback exists, opens independently and matches the tested version.
rules.verification_method: Record browser flow, replay file, verify narration/captions and list external dependencies.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Honest impact and capability
rules.acceptance: Every empirical numeric claim has source, date, denominator and scope. Projections list assumptions/range; user studies, team experience and deployments are never invented.
rules.verification_method: Audit website, slides, Wiki and README against claim ledger.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Measurable social impact framework
rules.acceptance: At least one domain-relevant outcome, baseline method, unit/denominator, comparison and collection plan exists; projected results are not reported as observed outcomes.
rules.verification_method: Check impact model and sensitivity table after problem verification.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Submission format and narrative
rules.acceptance: Official deck preserves supplied template structure; longer 12–18-slide talk deck is separate if it would violate template length. All source and problem-status caveats visible; no unsupported competition eligibility.
rules.verification_method: Inspect actual PPTX XML, render all slides and verify against user-supplied format.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Deployable and maintainable handoff
rules.acceptance: README includes install, config, migrate/seed, run, test, build, deploy, backup/restore and known limits. No unconfigured contact or demo link implies a functioning service.
rules.verification_method: Independent clean-start check and verify all advertised URLs/functions.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Attribution and channel integrity
rules.acceptance: Each cited source has title, publisher/author when known, original URL, access time, evidence type and claim mapping. Failed/private channels recorded as inaccessible, never described as scraped.
rules.verification_method: Audit source registry and match raw evidence to Wiki synthesis.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Real human validation
rules.acceptance: At least 5 representative non-author participants perform frozen navigation tasks; at least 3 non-author reviewers score narrative with anchored rubric. If unavailable, report unknown and do not claim benchmark saturation.
rules.verification_method: Retain anonymized task-level responses and reviewer scores; team-only rehearsal reported separately.
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

saturation_requires: Every objective benchmark meets target with preserved evidence.
Two consecutive full evaluated iterations show <2 percentage points improvement in each composite quality score and <5% relative latency improvement.
No new critical failure, unresolved blocker or missing human evaluation.
iteration_policy.deadline_policy: If the deadline arrives first, retain failed/unknown status and ship an honest gap list. Do not weaken thresholds, treat timeout as saturation, or fabricate results.
iteration_policy.retest_policy: Rerun affected tests after a change; rerun final acceptance only when release candidate changes.
